topic: Benchmark Axis Decomposition and Degradation Protocol
evidence: Rule 6: composite blueprints require named-axis decomposition. WabbleSpec standard axes: spec-compliance (0-25 pts), receipt-completeness (0-20), invariant-adherence (0-20), verification-gate-pass (0-20), language-precision (0-15). Excludes G0DM0D3 length bias (46.7% weight) and anti-refusal axis (26.1%). Rule 7: degradation analysis before composite gate acceptance — zero each axis one at a time, confirm weight ordering matches expectation (spec-compliance drop > receipt-completeness drop etc.), document as axis_calibration_run: true with per-axis deltas. benchmark.schema.json: axes array added (axis enum, weight, operationalization, score_in_calibration_run) and axis_calibration_run boolean. 7 total rules in benchmark-discipline.md. Rules 1-5 from previous build; Rules 6-7 from G0DM0D3 Wave 6 (0.8.4).
